scope: Resident single-compartment core on historical Task35 states; phase 1 of cost mapping. No native regeneration, optimizer, architecture selection or whole-simulator speed claim.
timing: Interleave/reverse order across arms and components; synchronize before and after each block; store wall and CUDA event samples separately; exclude compile and input staging. Bootstrap paired block differences with seed 81502 and 2000 resamples; no simultaneous GPU training.
oracle: Cached gates computed from the same frozen input state; they are diagnostic buffers, not a causal online model. Removed-gate latency estimates workload-specific attainable savings, not an additive physical cost or guaranteed upper bound after compiler reorganization.
decision: No model promotion. Report paired savings and uncertainty for replacing gate updates in the whole resident core. The memory/computation architecture question is revised from this measured opportunity. No threshold for a candidate speedup is selected here; candidate quality/runtime thresholds must be preregistered before its training/search.
exclusions: Native host generation of presynaptic events, plasticity and RNG; H2D/D2H; loading, compile, training; axial coupling. IE-02 whole-simulator cost mapping remains incomplete until excluded work is measured under a deployable implementation.
ionic_interface: V[mV], Ca[mM], 18 physical gate states or explicitly initialized z, gbar multipliers, fixed reversals and dt; outputs gate memory or channel conductances plus calcium current at declared phase. Calcium uses updated Ca gate openings at old V; SK reads newly advanced Ca, per Task35. Membrane/synapse/Ca laws unchanged.
failure: Stop on immutable source, shape, compile or numerical preflight failure; save failure_report and log; never silently fall back to eager and report compiled timings. Native and CUDA runtimes are not mixed.
next: Use result to complete IE-03 target selection and IE-04 interface; IE-05 new isolated playground needs separate numerical preregistration. No IE-06 training authorized by a technical pass alone.
